title: New Trees in the Neighborhood!
description:
Trees are pretty incredible, and now the Linda Vista community has 241 more of them! 🌳✨ These trees were planted as part of our Ready, Set, Grow San Diego initiative.

These new trees will help clean our air, provide shade, capture stormwater, and make our neighborhoods healthier every day!

This work is supported by the USDA Forest Service.
